_note: Design targets for Pratala (MATH.md). Ranges are [low, high], null = open end. Checked by .claude/skills/stake-math/scripts/math_profile.py. Set on 2026-11-16 from the design model, before the full simulation was read.

base._feature_every: the reels give 1 in 294.8 unforced; the solved rate should sit within about 5% of it
base._max_win_every: Engine: more often than 1 in 10,000,000, kept 20% clear of it; rarer than 1 in 2,000,000 keeps it a headline
base._win_below_cost_of_hits: no agreed limit; a single low-symbol win is below the bet in every scatter pays game (SDK sample: 56%)

boost._feature_every: the base rate: boost buys the strike, not more free spins

bonus._pays_back_cost: design model: 23%; the package before this one gave 17%

super._cost: natural value / RTP, to the nearest 5
super._shape: the steady buy: a lit floor from the first spin. Design model: 24% / 0.47 / 11%

hoard._cost: natural value / RTP, to the nearest 5; 500x or less keeps the full $1,000 bet template
hoard._shape: the wild buy: a gaze before every spin builds late, so it returns its cost less often and reaches the max win most often. Design model: 18% / 0.33 / 18%
